read_record.instructions: User AGENTS.md supplied in chat; no additional repository AGENTS.md found
read_record.context: AI_CONTEXT.md current status and sections 45-49 used for environment/data/interfaces only
read_record.versions: Exact local source/config hashes in PINS.json and source_snapshot.json; server actual runtime/import/config and accepted extraction identities recorded before model construction

host.modalities: processed_lidar only; radar/cameras remain native reading dependencies
host.initialization: random official create_model, same uint32 seed; independently seeded auxiliary initialization inside fork_rng
host.adaptations: frame Mix3 suffix selection; retain background instead of recursive zero-GT resampling; remove native random empty-cloud filler; fixed zero sparse padding voxel for empty CAV, its pillar feature explicitly zeroed before scatter, never a GT/ray point or real-point filter
host.geometry_augmentation: identity. Native IntermediateFusionDataset does not call configured world flip/rotation/scale. Unexpected invocation raises; point order shuffle remains independently seeded. No cached labels are pasted onto transformed input.

groups.E0: detection only; never construct auxiliary head or load paired Clean auxiliary samples
groups.E1: native detection plus conditional epsilon prediction; positive O_raw, negative complement
groups.E2: same as E1, supervise positive O and negative E only
groups.E3: same as E2, positive loss averaged within ego and peer-only groups, then across nonempty groups

geometry.coordinates: Native current-frame params.transformation_matrix transforms source LiDAR endpoints AND [0,0,0] sensor origin into ego once; poses use x,y,z,roll,yaw,pitch in degrees. Native box order hwl and radians; YAML extent is half-size handled by original object-center code.
geometry.source: Only paired training Clean raw native PCD reader; Open3D unpacks RGB red /255 intensity, supports ASCII and binary. No row-wise weather correspondence.
geometry.allowed_information: Native first7 registered CAVs, 70m communication, local native range/self-point removal, native ego camera FOV and ego feature range; no GT-filled solids. Nearest return is established on the original ray before spatial/FOV filtering.
geometry.endpoint_rule: Reject degenerate sensor-origin returns <=1e-6m; actual endpoints own floor((p-window_lower)/voxel). Lower faces included, upper faces excluded. No endpoint dilation or voxel snapping.
geometry.free_margin_reason: Exceeds one label voxel diagonal sqrt(.4^2+.4^2+.5^2)=.755m, leaving a conservative endpoint guard. Chosen from voxel scale, never AP.
geometry.free_rule: Finite line/grid intersection of observed nearest returns only; minimum interior crossing length .1m; stop .8m before return; all corners of a free voxel inside ego feature support and camera frustum. Grazing/zero-length crossings remain unknown.
geometry.same_direction: Per sensor azimuth bin floor(((azimuth+.5e-5rad) mod 2pi)/1e-5rad), elevation round(elevation/1e-5rad), including angular seam handling; nearest recorded range supplies free evidence, all allowed actual endpoints supply hits. No missing fired beams inferred. Coarser-bin return merging conservatively suppresses free evidence.
geometry.conflict: O=O_raw AND NOT E_raw; E=E_raw AND NOT O_raw; U=NOT(O OR E), including O_raw AND E_raw
geometry.meaning: Conservative ray-sampling approximation, not complete physical occupancy ground truth; acquisition has no explicit ring/beam or multipath-certainty metadata. Unmeasured/behind-return regions remain U; uncertain nonfinite/degenerate returns are rejected.
geometry.windows: Native training Clean final GT center x/y plus uniform +-1.6m, up to8 without replacement; fixed z=-1 and fixed12.8x12.8x4, axis aligned, no GT-size scaling/yaw rotation. Extra Clean training supervision is explicitly disclosed.
geometry.cache: Atomic per-frame NPZ with float64 ego endpoints/origins, int16 sensor source, nearest-return flags, per-target conservative segment AABB candidate indices covering all jitter. Per-sample/epoch 4 packed Boolean masks and centers prepared once and reused by E1/E2/E3. Query/trace only local windows, no scene-wide dense3D grid.
geometry.cache_size: Estimate raw rays/origins about50 bytes/ray before compression plus candidate indices, per window masks4096 bytes before compression. Actual bytes/rate/progress recorded, resume granularity one frame and one frame-epoch. Main caches on OUTPUT_ROOT only.
geometry.source_groups: ego=O with ego endpoint support; peer=O with any peer support and no ego support; intersections assigned to ego once

diffusion.x0: +1 on O_raw, -1 everywhere else for ALL E1/E2/E3; U values are placeholders in E2/E3
diffusion.xt: sqrt(alpha_bar[t])*x0+sqrt(1-alpha_bar[t])*epsilon; same seed/epoch/UID/window deterministic stream, no group input
diffusion.beta: linear 1e-4 to .02; one random timestep per training window, no reverse sampling
diffusion.architecture: 8x32x32 input/output; double-conv GroupNorm SiLU UNet widths32/64/128, average-pool encoder, nearest decoder and skips. Corresponding fused384-channel BEV window extracted by bilinear four-neighbour index_select, zeros, align_corners=False; strict deterministic backward; conv1x1 to64 condition tokens; token mean and sinusoidal time embedding modulate128-channel bottleneck by scale/shift. No detach.
diffusion.detector_path: Only processed_lidar/record_len; target/GT/masks never enter detector. FeatureTap is an observer, no state keys. Export detector.state_dict strictly reloads official class. Evaluation worker never imports generation module.

loss.definition: d_i=(epsilon_hat_i-epsilon_i)^2. m(S)=sum_{i in S} d_i / |S| for nonempty S. Empty S omitted, never divide by zero.
loss.E1: P=O_raw, N=NOT O_raw; mean of available m(P), m(N)
loss.E2: P=O, N=E; mean of available m(P), m(N)
loss.E3: m(P)=mean of available m(ego),m(peer); then mean of available m(P),m(E)
loss.weights: With both classes present positive total=.5 and negative total=.5. For k nonempty positive source groups each positive position has weight1/(2*k*|group|); negative1/(2*|E|). One nonempty class gets total1. No nonempty class yields0.
loss.windows: Mean over ALL selected windows including zero-loss all-U windows; no GT/window yields differentiable zero and keeps detection sample. Microbatch means accumulated to effective batch8, same microbatch all groups.
loss.joint: L_det+.1*L_gen E1-E3; L_det E0. lambda=.1 is a preregistered starting point, not an optimized result. First microbatch per epoch records separate detection/generation gradients on pillar encoder/fusion parameters and fused BEV.

training.default: seed20261019,20 epochs/group,effective batch8,FP32,Adam lr.002 eps1e-10 wd1e-4
training.sampling: 8083 base frames, one weather per cooperative frame with independent probability1/3 each; no expansion/replacement; group-independent order/weather/point-shuffle/window/diffusion streams
training.tail: Shuffle once per epoch, drop same final3 frames for full8083; retain8080,1010 effective updates per group/epoch. microbatch fixed from E3 empirical capacity check8/4/2/1, accumulation1/2/4/8. BN uses common chosen microbatch.
training.scheduler: MultiStepLR milestones[10,15],gamma.1; step() after all updates of completed epoch. Epoch1-10 lr.002,11-15 .0002,16-20 .00002.
training.resume: Own source/config/input/seed and selected microbatch immutable. Save model,aux,Adam,scheduler,criterion,RNG Python/NumPy/Torch CPU/HIP,globalstep,sampler,accumulation boundary,FP32 scaler=null. Training commit precedes validation commit. Partial epoch reruns from previous train commit; evaluation failure never retrains committed epoch.
training.compute: All groups use strict deterministic_algorithms=True/warn_only=False, cudnn benchmark=False/deterministic=True; resume v3 tolerances unchanged. New output; prior data caches only may be verified and imported.

protocols.O: current official weather GT, prediction=None skips whole frame
protocols.O*: same weather GT, None=zero predictions, retainGT
protocols.F: D-1C frozen Clean ID/order/geometry, None=zero predictions, retainGT

evaluation.metric: BEV AP30/50/70, VOC2010,global_sort=False,fixed frame order,strict score>.20,NMS.15
evaluation.selection: All epochs complete; highest Clean O AP70 maximum M; eligible M-Clean<=.005; maximize mean Fog/Snow O AP70, full precision, exact ties earliest epoch
evaluation.isolation: Each epoch training process exits before independent evaluation process. Frozen inference RNG seed/PYTHONHASHSEED20261016. One prediction per weather/frame reused for3 protocols. No validation generation labels. No formal test. No performance-based cancellation.

policy.scope: Same settings for E0/E1/E2/E3 and inference; no change to v3 resume tolerances
policy.limitation: Determinism is validated on the accepted software/device; no cross-platform guarantee

compute_policy.user_authorization: 2026-10-20: fix calculation, retain v3 resume acceptance
